call.title: Introductory call transcript
call.text:
I DO! VENDOR INTRODUCTION
Call transcript | November 1, 2026, 10:00 a.m.
Rep: Jamie Rivera | Vendor: Sam Taylor, Good Company DJs
FICTIONAL SAMPLE SOURCE

[00:00] Jamie: Tell me about what you do and who you are a good fit for.
[00:19] Sam Taylor: We offer Wedding DJ, ceremony sound, MC services, dance floor lighting. Our style is Open-format dance music; collaborative playlist planning. Capacity-wise, Up to 250 guests; one event per DJ per day.

[02:10] Jamie: Walk me through what's included and what you need.
[02:22] Sam Taylor: Standard service is 6 hours. The team is One DJ / MC. We can customize with Custom edits; uplighting; additional sound zones. Exclusions are Live musicians and stage rental. From the venue or client, we need Two dedicated 20A outlets; covered level performance area.

[06:05] Jamie: How do bookings and payments work?
[06:20] Sam Taylor: The deposit is 30% non-refundable retainer. The balance is due 30 days before the event. We recommend booking 9–12 months ahead.
[07:02] Jamie: And changes or cancellations?
[07:14] Sam Taylor: Retainer is non-refundable; within 30 days the full balance is due. For rescheduling: One date change within 12 months, subject to availability.

[09:35] Jamie: What happens on the day?
[09:46] Sam Taylor: 90 minutes for sound check and setup. Our backup plan is Backup controller, laptop, and wireless microphone.
[10:50] Jamie: What about delivery and deadlines?
[11:02] Sam Taylor: The deadline on the website is vague. I will send the actual planning or fulfillment deadline. I'll email you the latest timeline.

[13:12] Jamie: Please also confirm the package prices and send insurance documentation.
[13:25] Sam Taylor: The website rates are out of date. I'll send our current rate card and a follow-up email. I still need to send our certificate.

[14:00] Jamie: Thanks. We will keep the profile pending until the documents are reviewed.

From: Sam Taylor <sam@goodcompany.example>
To: Jamie Rivera <jamie@bubs.example>

Subject: Current pricing, timeline, and outstanding documents
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

FICTIONAL SAMPLE EMAIL

Hi Jamie,

Thanks for the call yesterday. Please use $2,400 as our current entry starting price. The website's $2,000 rate is from last season; the attached 2027 rate card has the correct packages.

Our confirmed delivery / planning timeline is: Music plan finalized 14 days before event. Please use this instead of the old or incomplete timeline discussed on the call.

Our applicable licenses are current, but I have not supplied supporting documentation yet. I will send our insurance certificate separately; it is not attached to this email.

Best,
Sam Taylor
